versions.changelog:
Maejongdeok Clinic Booking v1.0.0

- Initial release of the booking assistant for 梅宗德医院.
- Supports viewing clinic info, making appointments, price inquiries, and online consultation.
- Simple intent flows: view guide, open details, book, consult, check prices, and download app.
- No external dependencies; runs on Node.js built-in modules only.
- Multi-language support (Chinese, English) included.
